name: Ritz-Carlton, Turks & Caicos
insider_take: This Caribbean gem sits on Grace Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's most beautiful beaches, where powdery white sand meets crystal-clear turquoise waters in a setting so pristine it feels almost surreal.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton sits on 14 miles of uninterrupted Grace Bay Beach, home to the world's third-largest coral reef system. The hotel's signature restaurant, Parallel23, features the island's only beach-to-table dining concept, sourcing conch and lobster directly from local fishermen. The property also houses the region's most extensive rum collection with over 150 Caribbean rums.
pro_tip: Visit during conch season (October-April) when the hotel offers exclusive conch diving experiences with marine biologists, followed by a cooking class featuring your fresh catch.
dont_miss: The Thursday night beach bonfire with traditional rake-and-scrape music, complimentary conch fritters, and storytelling by local historians. Also, book the sunrise yoga sessions on the beach – Grace Bay faces east, offering spectacular dawn views with virtually no crowds at 6 AM.
pros: Pristine Grace Bay Beach location with powdery white sand
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Luxurious suites with private terraces and ocean views
cons: Remote island location requires connecting flights
